task: authoritative server-side step-safety + budget binding + safe rescheduling

real_code_facts.new_reservation_requires_no_unconfirmed_: services/backend/app/research_continuation.py:309-310 rejects a new reservation while any row is non-settled
real_code_facts.dispatch_marks_outcome_unknown: services/backend/app/research_continuation.py:563-567 claim_continuation_dispatch sets status=outcome_unknown before crossing the process boundary
real_code_facts.settlement_bounds: services/backend/app/research_continuation.py:631-636 settlement requires charged_tokens/settlement_sha256 and cannot exceed the original reservation
real_code_facts.budget_is_in_row_jsonb: research_tasks.continuation_budget is a JSONB column; there is no per-event_key unique constraint and no pg_advisory_xact_lock on the continuation path
real_code_facts.advisory_lock_is_elsewhere: pg_advisory_xact_lock is used only by research_receipt_watches in services/backend/app/research_receipts.py:86-87
real_code_facts.call_evidence_pk: services/backend/app/domain_call_admission.py:29-42 agent_domain_call_evidence PRIMARY KEY (owner_principal, workspace_id, session_id, sequence)
real_code_facts.adapter_call_sequence: services/runtime-adapter/app/lifecycle_journal.py:552-559 observe_call enforces sequence == len(calls)+1; runtime.py:1855-1858 records domain-call-observed.v1 rows

contract_mapping.keep_closed: packages/contracts/session_failure_containment.py (classify_recovery, loss causes, terminal kinds, recovery statuses/reasons, generation/epoch/attempt fence, RECOVERY_ATTEMPT_MAX=3)
contract_mapping.step_safety_registry: closed, provider-independent per-action {idempotent, result_verifiable} registry derived from domain_call_admission.ACTIONS; ordinary closed contract extension; unlisted actions are unknown

authoritative_source.occurred_step_set: agent_domain_call_evidence rows for the SAME (owner_principal, workspace_id, session_id, trace_id, root_run_id, generation, agent_run_id), read ORDER BY sequence
authoritative_source.sequence_closure: sequence starts at 1 and is strictly contiguous; primary-key uniqueness forbids duplicates; a gap, out-of-range sequence, or unreadable/conflicting row is not evidence
authoritative_source.per_call_binding: for every observed call, bind persisted (action, task_id, idempotency_key, request_sha256, input_sha256) and reconcile via agent_domain_call_claims keyed by (root_run_id, task_id, action, idempotency_key)
authoritative_source.step_safety: BYQ domain contract registry, never the client/prompt/display strings; a step is safe only when its action is declared idempotent and result_verifiable and its exact receipt is settled

call_evidence_reconciliation.eligible_condition: ALL occurred side effects settled AND every action in the work to replay declared idempotent + result_verifiable

budget_binding.withdrawn_semantics: withdrawn - creating a new continuation reservation after loss is impossible because a new reservation is rejected while any row is non-settled and a lost dispatch leaves its row outcome_unknown
budget_binding.persisted_location: the existing research_tasks.continuation_budget row R (same reservation_id, event_key, token_limit)
budget_binding.in_row_addition: bounded recovery_attempts:[{attempt,status,run_id,charged_tokens?}] plus recovery_attempt counter on R
budget_binding.real_concurrency_mechanism: task-row SELECT ... FOR UPDATE via _continuation_task plus in-transaction event-key scan/dedup; no per-event_key unique constraint; no pg_advisory_xact_lock on this path

formula.unresolved: sum(token_limit over rows with status in {reserved, accepted, outcome_unknown})
formula.known_charge: 0 if R.status==reserved; c if the adapter guard receipt for the exact reservation_id reconciles to R and the run; None otherwise
formula.reservation_remaining: None if known_charge is None else R.token_limit - known_charge
formula.available: None if reservation_remaining is None else min(permission_remaining, reservation_remaining)
formula.budget_available: blocked if revoked/expired/turns_remaining<=0/available<single_call_floor; None if known_charge is None or any input unreadable; True otherwise subject to recovery_attempt < RECOVERY_ATTEMPT_MAX

state_table.guard_receipt: present, identity matches R and run
state_table.budget_available: min(P_remaining, R.token_limit-c) if >= floor else blocked
blocked if P revoked/expired/turn cap/ordinal cap

safe_rescheduling.receipt_first: query the exact prompt receipt and adapter guard receipt for R.reservation_id before deciding; success -> settled (never replay); conflict -> blocked; unresolved charge -> paused
safe_rescheduling.bounded: recovery_attempt < RECOVERY_ATTEMPT_MAX=3 and available >= single_call_floor; sum of attempt charges never exceeds R.token_limit; permission max_turns/expires_at/revocation still apply
safe_rescheduling.attempt_ordinal_identity: recovery-v1:<sha256(event_key + interrupted_run_id + ':' + k)> is the audit/reconciliation identity of ordinal k, NOT a uniqueness key
safe_rescheduling.exactly_one_per_ordinal: the recovery_attempt counter is incremented under the task-row SELECT ... FOR UPDATE, so concurrent calls for the same ordinal are exactly-once
safe_rescheduling.auditable: loss evidence stays in the fenced adapter containment ledger; attempt charges/run ids stay on R; no second store and no /tmp authority
safe_rescheduling.fenced: stale executor epoch, stale/duplicate generation, late settlement and terminal reopen fail closed (FencedWrite)

failure_semantics.unknown_cost_outcome_unknown_no_receipt: paused, never refunded and never settled as 0
failure_semantics.ordinary_failed_cancelled_discarded_clos: keep ordinary semantics; interrupted projected only from fenced containment matching the same session/trace and exact run

next_slice_acceptance_criteria: closed step-safety registry derived from domain_call_admission.ACTIONS; unlisted actions are unknown
recovery reads the exact owned call-evidence rows by sequence, enforces contiguity, and reconciles each call against its exact per-call receipt
original-row rearm only: no new continuation_budget row, no budget reset; outcome_unknown liability resolved from the adapter guard receipt or the judgement stays paused
recovery_attempt ordinal allocated atomically under the task-row FOR UPDATE, bounded by RECOVERY_ATTEMPT_MAX=3; concurrent same-ordinal calls are exactly-once; transport dispatch_attempts is separate
receipt-first: success receipt -> settled (no prompt); conflict -> blocked; non-idempotent/unknown/zero-evidence -> paused
fenced: stale epoch/generation/attempt and terminal reopen fail closed
fail-able observer plus negative controls (unknown-liability, previous-unconfirmed rejection, zero/gap call evidence, concurrent ordinal) that a result-trusting gate would misreport
no runtime code change in this design slice; no production selector change, deploy, release/tag, Phase 100 resume or D15 superseding assessment

adr_decision.rationale: only extends already-authorized BYQ components: the existing research_tasks.continuation_budget row (same authority/row with an in-row bounded recovery sub-record, not an independent store); a closed contract surface (session_failure_containment plus a closed step-safety registry module, not a persistence authority); the existing per-call receipts and ordered call evidence (not a new trust subject); the existing Gateway->Backend /internal/task-continuation seam (an added operation) and the existing adapter dispatch path (not a new Plane boundary or cross-Plane interface); the ADR-0084 gate classification is unchanged
decision_points: recovery-attempt persistence is an addition to the existing authoritative task row, not an independent store
the step-safety registry is an ordinary closed contract extension
the Gateway->Backend task-continuation seam already exists; recovery adds an operation on it
no new trust subject, database migration, or gate-classification change
future_triggers_requiring_a_proposed_adr: a new public/internal cross-Plane authority interface
a database schema/migration such as a per-event_key unique index
a change to the ADR-0084 gate classification
